title: SQL Standard Temporal Support
summary: Temporal features of the SQL standard (ISO/IEC 9075), introduced in SQL:2011 — application-time period tables and system-versioned tables.
body_markdown:
# SQL Standard Temporal Support

## Scope

Period definitions on tables; application-time period tables (valid time); system-versioned tables (transaction time); temporal predicates and query syntax such as `FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF`.

## Requirements

DBMS conformance varies per product and feature; check each product.

## Applicability

Physical realization of [[System-Versioned History Table]] and [[Bitemporal Data Model]].

## Related Architecture Concepts

[[Temporal Data Management]].

## Related Controls

None.
